Birthday Invitation Wording: Examples for Every Kind of Party

Find clear birthday invitation wording for kids, adults, milestone parties, family dinners and virtual celebrations, plus a checklist of details to include.

A useful birthday invitation answers the practical questions before guests need to ask: who is celebrating, when and where to arrive, how to respond and whether there is anything to bring. The wording can be warm, playful or formal, but the important details should be easy to find. Use these examples as starting points and personalise the names, date, time and venue.

Invitation Ideas10 min readUpdated 17 November 2026

The essential details every birthday invitation needs

Make the event easy to understand

Include the host or birthday person’s name, the occasion, the full date, start time, venue or meeting link and a way to RSVP. For a home party, add the address privately to the guest list rather than posting it publicly.

Add useful context

Mention an age or milestone only when the person is comfortable sharing it. Include dress guidance, parking, accessibility notes, food arrangements or a plan for children when those details affect guests. For an online party, specify the platform, time zone and approximate end time.

Short and casual birthday invitation wording

For friends

“It’s [Name]’s birthday! Come celebrate with us on [date] at [time] at [place]. Good food, good company and birthday cake. Let us know by [RSVP date] if you can make it.”

For a small family gathering

“We’re getting together to celebrate [Name]. Join us for a relaxed birthday meal on [date] at [time]. Please reply to [contact] by [date] so we can plan the table.”

Birthday invitation wording for children and family parties

For a child’s birthday

“[Name] is turning [age]! You’re invited to an afternoon of games, cake and fun on [date], from [start time] to [end time], at [venue]. Please let [parent/host] know by [RSVP date].”

For a family celebration

“Our family is celebrating [Name]’s birthday and we would love to have you with us. Join us on [date] at [time] at [venue]. Your company will make the day even more special.”

Milestone and formal birthday invitation examples

For a milestone birthday

“Please join us as [Name] celebrates [milestone] on [date]. Reception begins at [time] at [venue]. Kindly respond to [contact] by [RSVP date].”

For a more formal dinner

“You are warmly invited to an evening in honour of [Name]’s birthday. Dinner will be served at [time] on [date] at [venue]. We would be grateful for your reply by [RSVP date].”

Virtual birthday party invitation wording

Make online instructions clear

“Celebrate [Name] with us online! Join the video party on [date] at [time] [time zone]. We’ll meet on [platform] for about [duration]. Reply to [contact] and we’ll send the joining link.”

For friends in different time zones

Write the time zone next to the time and, if guests are spread across countries, consider including a second time reference. Send the joining link only to invited guests and avoid placing private meeting details on a public page.

Turn the invitation into a digital page

Use a web invitation when details may change

A digital invitation can bring the message, event information, map or location note and visual theme together. Wishly has an Invitation Cards collection and occasion-specific templates; review the selected design to see which fields and interactions it actually supports.

Plan how guests will respond

If the design provides an RSVP or reply form, test it before sending. If not, include a clear phone number, email address or messaging contact for replies. Do not imply that every invitation template has an RSVP form.

The final invitation checklist

Proofread before sending

Check spelling of names, date, weekday, time zone, venue, RSVP deadline and contact details. Send a test link to yourself, open it on a phone and make sure guests can find the most important information without searching.

Frequently asked questions

How early should I send a birthday invitation?

For a small local gathering, send it early enough for guests to keep the date free. Larger events, travel or school-holiday dates need more notice. Set the RSVP deadline according to when you must confirm food or venue arrangements.

What should I write if the party is online?

Include the date, time zone, platform, approximate duration and how guests will receive the joining link. Make the RSVP method clear.

Does every Wishly invitation have an RSVP form?

No. Wishly says interactions vary by template. Check the invitation preview and, if there is no response form, provide a separate contact method for guests.
